verdict.rationale: Retell's AI QA automatically evaluates a sampled set of calls against configured rules and metrics, scoring hallucination, knowledge-base accuracy, latency, sentiment and tool usage. Built-in call-success scoring covers resolution, and Conductor examines failures and the calls behind low scores. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, explicit documentation of resolution analysis beyond call-success scoring, and coverage of all calls rather than a sampled set.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's AI reviews my calls for me — scoring quality, flagging failures, and analyzing resolution automatically

citations.quote: AI QA scores Retell calls on hallucination, knowledge base accuracy, latency, sentiment, and tool usage to surface quality trends and issues.
AI QA automatically evaluates a sampled set of your calls against rules and metrics you configure.
Built-in call success and sentiment scoring, plus custom fields synced to your CRM.
Ask it to explain a trend or examine the calls behind a low score.
Filter conversations, inspect transcripts and tool calls, and compare failures to find agent improvements.
